From d793458c45df2aed498d7f74145eab7ee22d25aa Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>
Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 08:23:45 -0800
Subject: [PATCH] nfc: rawsock: cancel tx_work before socket teardown

In rawsock_release(), cancel any pending tx_work and purge the write
queue before orphaning the socket.  rawsock_tx_work runs on the system
workqueue and calls nfc_data_exchange which dereferences the NCI
device.  Without synchronization, tx_work can race with socket and
device teardown when a process is killed (e.g. by SIGKILL), leading
to use-after-free or leaked references.

Set SEND_SHUTDOWN first so that if tx_work is already running it will
see the flag and skip transmitting, then use cancel_work_sync to wait
for any in-progress execution to finish, and finally purge any
remaining queued skbs.

Fixes: 23b7869c0fd0 ("NFC: add the NFC socket raw protocol")
Reviewed-by: Joe Damato <joe@dama.to>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260303162346.2071888-6-kuba@kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

diff --git a/net/nfc/rawsock.c b/net/nfc/rawsock.c
index b049022399ae..f7d7a599fade 100644
--- a/net/nfc/rawsock.c
+++ b/net/nfc/rawsock.c
@@ -67,6 +67,17 @@ static int rawsock_release(struct socket *sock)
 	if (sock->type == SOCK_RAW)
 		nfc_sock_unlink(&raw_sk_list, sk);
 
+	if (sk->sk_state == TCP_ESTABLISHED) {
+		/* Prevent rawsock_tx_work from starting new transmits and
+		 * wait for any in-progress work to finish.  This must happen
+		 * before the socket is orphaned to avoid a race where
+		 * rawsock_tx_work runs after the NCI device has been freed.
+		 */
+		sk->sk_shutdown |= SEND_SHUTDOWN;
+		cancel_work_sync(&nfc_rawsock(sk)->tx_work);
+		rawsock_write_queue_purge(sk);
+	}
+
 	sock_orphan(sk);
 	sock_put(sk);
 
-- 
2.34.1

### Summary of Modifications

**File changed:** `net/nfc/rawsock.c`

**Modification:**  
In the `rawsock_release` function, a new block of code is inserted before the calls to `sock_orphan(sk)` and `sock_put(sk)`. The added code performs three actions when the socket state is `TCP_ESTABLISHED`:

1. **Sets the `SEND_SHUTDOWN` flag** on the socket (`sk->sk_shutdown |= SEND_SHUTDOWN`) to prevent `rawsock_tx_work` from starting any new transmissions.
2. **Cancels any pending or running `tx_work`** using `cancel_work_sync(&nfc_rawsock(sk)->tx_work)`, ensuring that no work item is still executing after this point.
3. **Purges the write queue** via `rawsock_write_queue_purge(sk)` to free any remaining queued skbs.

**Purpose and relationship:**  
The change fixes a race condition in the NFC raw socket release path. Without synchronization, `rawsock_tx_work` (which runs on the system workqueue and dereferences the NCI device) could execute concurrently with socket and device teardown when a process is killed abruptly (e.g., by SIGKILL). This could lead to use-after-free or leaked references.

The fix ensures that:
- Before the socket is orphaned (which can invalidate the NCI device reference), any in‑flight `tx_work` is stopped and all queued data is cleaned up.
- The `SEND_SHUTDOWN` flag is set first so that if `tx_work` is already running, it will check the flag and skip transmitting.
- `cancel_work_sync` provides a barrier, waiting for any currently executing work to finish before proceeding with teardown.

Thus, the modification properly serializes the work queue operation with socket release, preventing the race with device teardown.

Here is the commit message:
nfc: rawsock: cancel tx_work before socket teardown

In rawsock_release(), cancel any pending tx_work and purge the write
queue before orphaning the socket.  rawsock_tx_work runs on the system
workqueue and calls nfc_data_exchange which dereferences the NCI
device.  Without synchronization, tx_work can race with socket and
device teardown when a process is killed (e.g. by SIGKILL), leading
to use-after-free or leaked references.

Set SEND_SHUTDOWN first so that if tx_work is already running it will
see the flag and skip transmitting, then use cancel_work_sync to wait
for any in-progress execution to finish, and finally purge any
remaining queued skbs.

Fixes: 23b7869c0fd0 ("NFC: add the NFC socket raw protocol")
Reviewed-by: Joe Damato <joe@dama.to>
Link: https://patch.msgid.link/20260303162346.2071888-6-kuba@kernel.org
Signed-off-by: Jakub Kicinski <kuba@kernel.org>

Here is the root cause:
The rawsock_release() function did not cancel the tx_work workqueue item or set the SEND_SHUTDOWN flag before orphaning the socket and putting it. This allowed rawsock_tx_work to continue running concurrently with socket and NCI device teardown, potentially accessing freed memory (use-after-free) or leaking references when the work executed after the device was freed. The race is triggered when a process is killed abruptly (e.g., by SIGKILL), causing immediate socket release without waiting for pending work to complete.

Here is the patch:
 
 static int rawsock_release(struct socket *sock)
 {
 	struct sock *sk = sock->sk;
 
 	pr_debug("sock=%p sk=%p\n", sock, sk);
 
 	if (!sk)
 		return 0;
 
 	if (sock->type == SOCK_RAW)
 		nfc_sock_unlink(&raw_sk_list, sk);
 
+	if (sk->sk_state == TCP_ESTABLISHED) {
+		/* Prevent rawsock_tx_work from starting new transmits and
+		 * wait for any in-progress work to finish.  This must happen
+		 * before the socket is orphaned to avoid a race where
+		 * rawsock_tx_work runs after the NCI device has been freed.
+		 */
+		sk->sk_shutdown |= SEND_SHUTDOWN;
+		cancel_work_sync(&nfc_rawsock(sk)->tx_work);
+		rawsock_write_queue_purge(sk);
+	}
+
 	sock_orphan(sk);
 	sock_put(sk);
 
 	return 0;
 }
